def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)]
    col_bounds = [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != 5 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            outrow.append(1 if count == 2 else 5)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
